gamerule.scpArchiveRepeatFiles.descripti: When on, printing a file at the Archive Terminal no longer takes it out of the pool, so any SCP can be printed again and again. Takes priority over per-player files.
gamerule.scpArchivePerPlayer.description: When on, printed files are tracked for each player instead of for the whole world, so every player can print one file of every SCP.
gamerule.scpDossierSpawning.description: When off, opening a sealed file only gives you the readable file for reference, such as for containment signs, and nothing arrives. Files opened earlier also stay quiet until it is turned back on.
config.scp_unleashed.chunk_loader.max_ra: Largest radius a chunk loader may be set to. Radius 0 is just its own chunk, radius r holds a (2r+1) x (2r+1) square.
config.scp_unleashed.chunk_loader.base_p: Flat SP/t every running chunk loader draws.
config.scp_unleashed.chunk_loader.power_: Extra SP/t drawn for every chunk a loader holds.
config.scp_unleashed.chunk_loader.grace_: Seconds a loader keeps its chunks while short of power before letting them go.
config.scp_unleashed.chunk_loader.chunks: How many new chunks one loader may pull in per tick while it spins up. Lower is gentler on the server.
config.scp_unleashed.notice_scale.toolti: Size of the system notices in the top left corner of the screen.
config.scp_unleashed.notice_offset_x.too: Moves the system notices to the right, in GUI pixels.
config.scp_unleashed.notice_offset_y.too: Moves the system notices down, in GUI pixels.
gamerule.scpFactionRaids.description: When on, factions that grow strong enough can raid the places where players live. Raids never happen on Peaceful.
gamerule.scpBlackBookCooldownDays: Z-0001: days before a black book takes ink again
gamerule.scpBlackBookCooldownDays.descri: After a name takes, a black book refuses new ink for this many in-game days. Days turn over at dawn. 0 removes the limit.
gamerule.scpDropAnomalies.description: When on and keepInventory is also on, players who die still drop every anomaly they carry, including sealed cases, occupied stasis pods, culture vials and anomalies packed in shulker boxes, bundles or backpacks. Everything else stays in their inventory.
config.scp_unleashed.anomaly_drops.shulk: With the drop anomalies on death game rule on, anomalies packed in shulker boxes also drop. The box itself stays with the player.
config.scp_unleashed.anomaly_drops.bundl: With the drop anomalies on death game rule on, anomalies packed in bundles also drop. The bundle itself stays with the player.
config.scp_unleashed.anomaly_drops.sophi: With the drop anomalies on death game rule on, anomalies packed in Sophisticated Backpacks also drop, whether the backpack is carried or worn.
config.scp_unleashed.anomaly_drops.backp: With the drop anomalies on death game rule on, anomalies packed in Backpacked backpacks also drop, whether the backpack is carried or equipped.
config.scp_unleashed.anomaly_drops.other: With the drop anomalies on death game rule on, anomalies packed in any other item that holds items also drop.
config.scp_unleashed.warhead_effects.too: Flashes, screen shake, the red alert overlay, the blast cloud, sirens and blast sounds of the Alpha Warhead. Turn off to skip them for you only. The countdown, announcements and the blast itself are unchanged.
config.scp_unleashed.post_effects.toolti: Full-screen blurs, hazes and vision filters, such as the SCP-106 pocket dimension blur, rift distortion and the flashbang blur. Turn off if they slow your game or clash with shader packs or other mods. Effects with a simple overlay show that instead.
gamerule.scpRedFingerDomains: Z-0002: the red finger can open its domain
gamerule.scpRedFingerDomains.description: When off, the red finger stays inert in every hand.
gamerule.scpZ0003PlayerTimeout: Z-0003: players break free after 30 seconds
gamerule.scpZ0003PlayerTimeout.descripti: When on, players held in stone by Z-0003 break free on their own after 30 seconds. D-Class, MTF operatives and villagers stay held.
gamerule.scpSerpentsHandRaids.descriptio: When on, the Serpent's Hand can raid the places where players live. Raids never happen on Peaceful.
gamerule.scpChaosInsurgencyRaids.descrip: When on, the Chaos Insurgency can raid the places where players live. Raids never happen on Peaceful.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.general.too: Master switch, default webhook, footer name, coordinates and sending limits.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.enabled.too: Master switch. While off nothing is ever sent to Discord. The webhook URLs are set in the Discord webhook file.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.server_name: Optional name shown in the footer of every embed.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.include_coo: Add block positions and the dimension to embeds. Each category can override this.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.rate_limit_: Most messages sent to one webhook per minute. Extra messages wait their turn.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.queue_limit: Most messages waiting to be sent. New messages are dropped while the queue is full.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.identity.to: How the webhook shows up in Discord.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.username.to: Optional name the webhook posts under. Empty keeps the name set in Discord.
Optional https image URL for the webhook's picture. Empty keeps the picture set in Discord.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.player_avat: Image URL for player faces. {uuid} and {name} are filled in. Empty sends no player images. The default loads faces from mc-heads.net, which shares player UUIDs with that service.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.players.ena: Post players events. The master switch must be on too.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.players.col: Embed colour as a hex code such as #3BA55C.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.players.coo: Default follows Include coordinates. On or Off overrides it for this category.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.documents.t: Players reading anomaly files and documents.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.documents.e: Post documents events. The master switch must be on too.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.documents.c: Embed colour as a hex code such as #3BA55C.
Default follows Include coordinates. On or Off overrides it for this category.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.anomalies.t: Anomalies arriving in the world and changes to their containment.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.anomalies.e: Post anomalies events. The master switch must be on too.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.anomalies.c: Embed colour as a hex code such as #3BA55C.
Default follows Include coordinates. On or Off overrides it for this category.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.security.to: Faction raids, MTF squads, the Alpha Warhead and other facility alarms.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.security.en: Post security events. The master switch must be on too.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.security.co: Embed colour as a hex code such as #3BA55C.
Default follows Include coordinates. On or Off overrides it for this category.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.computers.t: A copy of every computer chat message with its sender and computer, for moderators.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.computers.e: Post a copy of every computer chat message. The master switch must be on too.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.computers.c: Embed colour as a hex code such as #3BA55C.
Default follows Include coordinates. On or Off overrides it for this category.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.strangers.t: Mysterious strangers appearing to players, what they hand over and when they leave.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.strangers.e: Post strangers events. The master switch must be on too.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.strangers.c: Embed colour as a hex code such as #3BA55C.
Default follows Include coordinates. On or Off overrides it for this category.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.players.joi: Post when a player joins, with their face, a first join flag and the online count.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.players.dea: Off, Anomalies for deaths caused by anomalies only, or All.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.webhooks.se: Discord webhook URLs. Kept in their own file, which is never sent to players. Treat each one like a password.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.webhooks.de: Webhook URL used by every category that has no webhook of its own.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.webhooks.pl: Webhook URL for this category only. Empty uses the default webhook.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.webhooks.do: Webhook URL for this category only. Empty uses the default webhook.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.webhooks.an: Webhook URL for this category only. Empty uses the default webhook.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.webhooks.se: Webhook URL for this category only. Empty uses the default webhook.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.webhooks.co: Webhook URL for this category only. Empty uses the default webhook.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.webhooks.st: Webhook URL for this category only. Empty uses the default webhook.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.documents.s: Post when a player breaks the seal on a sealed file.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.documents.r: Off, FirstRead for only the first time each player opens each file, or EveryRead. FirstRead is remembered in the world save, and breaking a seal counts as the first read while opened sealed files are posted.
With EveryRead, how many minutes pass before the same player reading the same file is posted again. 0 posts every read.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.anomalies.a: Post when an anomaly surfaces or manifests in the world.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.anomalies.r: Post when an Apocalyptic Rift forms or collapses.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.anomalies.d: Post when the Daevite God is summoned or slain.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.anomalies.c: Off, Breaches for breaches only, or All to also post anomalies being contained again.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.security.mt: Post when a player calls in an MTF squad.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.security.me: Post when a fission reactor or a reactor tower melts down.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.security.ra: Off, Milestones for warnings, starts and endings only, or All to also post what happens during a raid.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.security.wa: Off, Countdown for countdowns, cancels and detonations only, or All to also post arming and disarming.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.computers.p: Post messages that players send through computer chat.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.computers.s: Post messages sent by scheduled computer actions.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.computers.a: Post anomalous messages that appear in computer chat.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.strangers.a: Post when a stranger appears to a player.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.strangers.d: Post what a stranger hands over.
config.scp_unleashed.skip_intro_cutscene: Skips the first-join intro on every world and server you join from now on. Server admins can also turn it off for everyone with the scpIntroCutscene game rule.
gamerule.scpIntroCutscene: Play the intro cutscene for new players
gamerule.scpIntroCutscene.description: New players see the SCP Unleashed intro once, the first time they join. When off, they skip straight into the world.
gamerule.scpChaosBreaching.description: When on, the Chaos Insurgency can blast a way into bases dug underground. Mob griefing must also be on.
config.scp_unleashed.seasons.halloween.t: Auto follows the server's calendar, 26 to 31 October. On keeps Halloween running all year and Off turns it off. Players always see what the server decides.
config.scp_unleashed.location_titles.too: Shows a title card the first time you arrive in certain anomalous places. The intro's own card is not affected.
Blocks two handheld radios reach each other without a booster tower.
config.scp_unleashed.voice.coverage_base: Base reach in blocks from a powered booster tower to handheld radios, before the bonus for masts.
config.scp_unleashed.voice.coverage_per_: Extra radio reach in blocks for every mast section.
config.scp_unleashed.voice.link_base.too: Base tower to tower link range in blocks, before the bonus for masts.
config.scp_unleashed.voice.link_per_mast: Extra tower to tower link range in blocks for every mast section.
config.scp_unleashed.voice.base_draw.too: Flat SP/t every booster tower with at least one mast draws.
config.scp_unleashed.voice.draw_per_mast: Extra SP/t drawn for every mast section.
config.scp_unleashed.voice.chat_prefix.t: Chat that starts with this text while holding a switched on radio goes out over the radio.
gamerule.scpRiftSpawning.description: When off, rifts no longer open on their own near players. Rifts that already exist stay open, and anything that opens a rift on purpose still works.
config.scp_unleashed.seasons.christmas.t: Auto follows the server's calendar, 20 to 26 December. On keeps Christmas running all year and Off turns it off. Players always see what the server decides.
config.scp_unleashed.voice.voice_recordi: Needs Simple Voice Chat. Master switch for anomalies that record short clips of players talking and replay them later. Clips are kept per anomaly in the world save. Players are told when they join and can delete their own clips with /scp_unleashed voice forgetme. When off, nothing is recorded or replayed and stored clips are left alone.
config.scp_unleashed.voice.clips_per_ano: Most voice clips kept for one anomaly. The oldest are removed first.
config.scp_unleashed.voice.clips_per_spe: Most voice clips kept of one player for one anomaly. The oldest are removed first.
Voice clips older than this are deleted when an anomaly's clips load and once every in-game day.
config.scp_unleashed.allow_voice_recordi: Whether servers may record your voice for anomalies and play it back. Turning it off stops new recordings and keeps your past clips from being played. /scp_unleashed voice forgetme deletes your past clips.
config.scp_unleashed.interface.tooltip: Title screen, loading screens and other interface options.
config.scp_unleashed.terminal_screens.to: Master switch for the terminal style title screen, loading screens, archive viewer, terminal sounds and screen effects. Turn off to use the normal screens.
config.scp_unleashed.terminal_menu.toolt: Show the terminal style title screen. Only applies while terminal screens are on.
config.scp_unleashed.terminal_loading.to: Show the terminal style screens while connecting, loading worlds, changing dimension, saving and disconnecting. Only applies while terminal screens are on.
config.scp_unleashed.terminal_theme.tool: Phosphor colour of the terminal screens.
config.scp_unleashed.terminal_sounds.too: Play the faint computer hum and keyboard clicks on the terminal screens.
config.scp_unleashed.terminal_reduced_mo: Skip the boot sequence and typing, and turn off flicker, the rolling band and blinking cursors. Also applies when the menu background speed is set to zero.
config.scp_unleashed.terminal_worlds.too: Show the world list, Create New World and Edit World screens in the terminal style. Only applies while terminal screens are on.
Scales the screen warping near reality-bending anomalies. Lower it if the effect is uncomfortable.
gamerule.scpWorldEndings.description: When off, no anomaly may delete the world or stop the server. The ending still plays, then everyone is released back into the world.
config.scp_unleashed.worldend.allow_worl: World endings may delete the world
config.scp_unleashed.mekhane.clear_secon: Seconds until the site goes dormant
config.scp_unleashed.scarlet.baseline_pe: Scarlet King: daily rise of the meter
config.scp_unleashed.scarlet.rite_2317_d: Scarlet King: drop from the SCP-2317 rite
config.scp_unleashed.scarlet.rite_2317_c: Scarlet King: days between SCP-2317 rites
config.scp_unleashed.scarlet.cultist_min: Scarlet King: fewest days between rituals
config.scp_unleashed.scarlet.cultist_max: Scarlet King: most days between rituals
config.scp_unleashed.scarlet.ritual_seco: Scarlet King: ritual length in seconds
config.scp_unleashed.scarlet.xk2_days: Scarlet King: days from XK-2 to the end
XK-class end of the world scenarios, from the first alarm to the end of the world, plus any other world ending.
Post XK scenario events. The master switch must be on too.
Embed colour as a hex code such as #8B0A1A. Good news and the end of the world keep their own colours.
Default follows Include coordinates. On or Off overrides it for this category.
Post when cultists finish a ritual for the Scarlet King. Repeats within ten minutes are held back.
config.scp_unleashed.discord.webhooks.ap: Webhook URL for this category only. Empty uses the default webhook.
config.scp_unleashed.scarlet_king.reset_: Seconds before an empty fight resets
config.scp_unleashed.orbital.edge_share: Damage share at the beam edge
config.scp_unleashed.scarlet_court.bride: Scarlet court: Bride in Chains health
config.scp_unleashed.scarlet_court.eyes_: Scarlet court: Daughter of Eyes health
config.scp_unleashed.scarlet_court.extra: Scarlet court: extra share per player
config.scp_unleashed.scarlet_court.hit_c: Scarlet court: largest share per hit
config.scp_unleashed.scarlet_court.envir: Scarlet court: share of attackerless damage
config.scp_unleashed.scarlet_court.cap_p: Scarlet court: extra minions per player
config.scp_unleashed.scarlet_court.breat: Scarlet court: rest after a daughter falls
config.scp_unleashed.scarlet_court.king_: Scarlet court: seconds between waves against the King
config.scp_unleashed.scarlet_court.openi: Scarlet court: wait before the first daughter
